notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Heya Clashers,

time for another update!

Ingame Messages
The short ingame messages (Good Game! (F9) Well played! (F10) Revanche?! (F11)) will now be sent and displayed to your opponents, even if they do not have activated the chat. The hotkeys for them also appear now when a nexus takes a hit.

Automated Server Restart
We have implemented an automated server restart on mondays at 2am CET. It will take about 15mins where CC is not available and aims at reducing accumulating problems.

Balance Changes
We are further tweaking some cards with (mostly smaller) changes. Most important:

- Lothar: Deals now some aoe damage in his landing zone.
- Braatu: While his hp and durability finally seems to be in the right place, his damage output especially at the opponent's nexus was too high. We removed siege and adapted his damage.
- Granite Guardian: Lost a little bit of its merit after the last patch. Mana cost goes down a bit.
- Hail of arrows: Kinda vanished and is therefore buffed with more waves.
- Saplings: Were used considerably less and needed some love. Living time is back to before.
- MOAG: We want do make more use of the Yamato cannon and reworked the whole card.
- Sentinals: Will now explode when they die and deal a small amount of aoe damage.

Patch Notes
https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes


Have fun and see you on the battlebeaches!!!

notes.title: New Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, today we are going to implement a new balance patch which has somewhat the theme "black is back". The black faction has been surpressed for quite a while now and is therefore getting a lot of buffs.

Spells like freeze and shatter ice get cheaper, frostgoyles get faster attack time, deep freeze enhances armor permanently - to name a few.  We also try something with the underplayed skeletons since they are able to attack banished units now and get their time stamp from the second life removed. In case this open ups a good new strategy with maelstrom and/or Tyrus, more changes in that regard may follow.

We also make the mulch digger a more pointed damage dealer by adding a shield-piercing ability and making him an apex predator with him also focussing on units with biggest hp in range.

With Factory reset getting  way cheaper it will become a more reactive play. However to not let it get out of hand we also had to reduce the amount of effected units/buildings accordingly.

Promise of life: The protection has been swapped out for healing.

Pulse of the forest got a change to make it more playable with smaller units. We therefore reduced the % of healing, while increasing the flat amount of healing. 

Legends

 Atlas was in need of a buff and gets some more base hp but also an increased healing by spells.
 Aegis annihilation now goes through Selga's protection. While not annihilating her, Aegis can now be an option for stopping a Selga Snowball.
 The Granite Guardian gets some minor nerfs in attack and asteroidal damage.
 Lothar takes less damage from surrounding friendly units when they are damaged.

See all changes: https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

notes.title: New patch - Balance and 2vs2 feature in silver
notes.notes:
Hey'all,
today we are going to implement a new patch. As usual, here is some background info regarding the most important balance changes.

It is also possible now to play with two decks on your own in silver tier as it is already the case in gold tier.

See you on the battlebeaches! ːsteamhappyː

Chain-Stall-Strategy
Using multiple spells one after another on own units to build a massive wave has been seen quite a lot. Likewise, doing something similar on opponent's units for incapacitation has also been used manyfold. Since there was no mechanism to prevent an endless chaining, these strategies became very nasty to play against. Accordingly, we increased immunity against stalling spells but also tuned several aoe spells down a little.

Stun-effect / Light Pulse
The stun on itself is not a big threat as it incapacitates units only for 3 seconds. Used with the cheap "light pulse" however, one could also chain it endlessly and power units like Atlas besides. Stun time has been reduced, mana cost increased. To make up for that, the blinding got buffed.

Turrets
The gattling turret is not a strong card at the moment and runs out of ammo quickly. We introduce a slow ammo refill.
The missile turret is a very strong high ranged damage dealer which has been used a lot. Because of its high energy need for ammo, it is not really playable in combos with energy providers. We want to change that and reduce cost of ammo, total energy capacity but also damage. Easier to play in combo but weaker alone.   

Overseer
We still like the concept of an air tank but it is still too weak. Damage output will be increased by some tweaks.

T2 and T3 Summonings
T2 and T3 summoning cost will be reduced by 10 mana. We aim at making them more usable. 

Entangling roots
Entangling roots is nice to play in the fight of the middle but falls of drastically later. We introduce some initial damage to it.

See all patch details here: https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

notes.title: Update today: New Ranking System in Gold, Balancing and some Skins
notes.notes:
Heya Clashers!

Update: Patch is live!

Later today another update will be implemented, which will introduce the previously announced new ranking system in Gold 2vs2! We hope that  there will be less fear of losing too many points, especially when players go alone into the queue and have random teammates. Enjoy! 
We will also add new Skins: the Blood Cauldrone and Blood Bane.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41599539/4c85586e48f4a848fd2008b3914448a72e809d10.jpg

In addtition, here are the most important background infos for balancing:

Lothar
Lothar has become the most dominant and played legend after the last patch. Heavy armor, high hp, fast attack speed and high damage of the swordmaster seem to make him mandatory in a deck at the moment. We tune him down a little by small adjustments in hp, attack speed but also increasing the cooldown for his Sun Shield ability (Combo with Solar Flare).

Selga
Having increased the radius of Selga's protection with the last patch seems to be the right decision. However, the amount of the now protected units can be a little op. Instead of decreasing the range back to former levels, we are going to decrease the time the invinceability is holding up. As this change will also effect Promise of life, the spell's cost will be reduced.

Factory reset
We want to increase the use of FR by reducing its cost.  As it has been op before, the amount of targeted units goes down likewise to prevent that from happening again.

Hail of Arrows
Hail of Arrows at its curent state is cheap aoe anywhere on the map without effort and it is surpressing decks that rely on small units. We will reduce the effected area, increase mana cost but also add a little bit of damage to make it a more pointed and tactical spell.

MOAG
The Moag is the most prominent damage dealer and could also be seen in close to every Tournament deck. We nerf general attack speed and energy cost for the Yamato cannon.

Relocate
Relocate is probably THE must have spell right now. Due to its versatility this is most likely not going to change completely but we want to tune its usefullness a little bit down by increasing mana cost.

T1 Melee Units
Most of the t1 melee units get an increase in health by 5-10%. In gold 2vs2 they are no real alternatives to t2 or t3 spawner and we try to change that.

T3 Summons
Over the last patches, we reduced the mana cost of t3 summons step by step to see them becoming a playable alternativ for either a t2 card or even a legend in a deck. As this has not happend yet, costs are reduced by 10 mana once again.

Towers in 1vs1
Get 10% more health and ammo.

All details later here: https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

notes.title: New Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hi all!
Here is some background  for the next balance patch which will be implented during the day.

The spore became the superstar after the last patch and has been seen in close to every match. At its current state it is anti air, healing but also a strong flying damage dealer. We tune down damage and healing accordingly.

T3 summons still do not feel like a real alternative to using legends, we therefore increase the mana cost for Brattu, Vecra, Lothar, Tyrus and Selga slightly again. More expensive legendaries do also require a more thoughtful use, which is good for tacticians.

Making Monument of life primarily a damage source didn't work out, so we are increasing its healing again. As the overhealing part caused lots of problems before, MoL is only going to heal but not overheal from now on.

The Mulch digger is always delicate to balance but it fell short in comparison to other tanks. Therefore, we increased the range of its ability invoke:rupture, which should also make the summoning more attractive.

Mirror Slime has rarely been seen after the cooldown of its reflector ability was increased with the last patch. We decreased it to the middle, reduced damage and increased hp.

Soul Cauldron has now medium instead of heavy armor.

These are most important changes, accompanied by some smaller tweaks.

All details: https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

Have fun!

notes.title: Big balance patch and some new features!
notes.notes:
Heya everyone!

It's been an interesting two month since the last balance patch! Now it is time for a new round and adjustments- this patch is most likely one of the biggest we have done in a pretty long time in regard to balancing. 🙂 As usual, we took into consideration feedback by our dearest community and also opinions by experienced players. To give you some background information, below are key changes that are introduced with the new patch. We are also happy to introduce some new features, as well, have a look!

Features
- Players will be notified when other players lose the connection or leave the match 

- Each player-level-border is displayed in the level-up-reward section now (top right, next to your profile icon) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41599539/1122f15c404f37adab3e78d76246c9414d3f0996.jpg

- Coloured ingame borders for spells Earthquake and Sapling Charge have been added (when activated in settings)

- Card-details (CD, damage, range und energy) have been added to the overview in the card vendor and can be found in the tooltip (hovering over the card). This allows a quicker access to information without having to use the deckbuilder. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41599539/de4d8c1d8b865b79d56f2a797217e87a2dded047.jpg



Balancing

Combos
Maelstrom/Freeze
Banishing units by maelstrom and consequently freezing them became very popular, because one could take out opponent's units for a long time - too long - out of the game. We tackled this by reducing both durations of banish and freeze but also by increasing mana cost for maelstrom and reducing affected units by it. The combo should still work but lose some of its oppressing nature.

Slime on ice
A (deep) frozen Mirror Slime was able to freeze a huge crowd of enemies in no time due to its mirror ability. We nerfed that by a reduction of the frozen status effect but also by a doubled cooldown time for this ability

Vecra Overhealed (with Solar Flare)
A frozen vecra constantly overhealed has been too tanky and hard to break free of her prison. The damage reduction in frozen state has therefore been changed from 90 to 70%. In the same regard Solar Flare got a nerf in healing from 400 to 300 hp and a small mana cost increase. This will also nerf the overhealing double Lothar combo.

Legends
Aegis
Aegis orbital drop and rift cannon are causing trouble, when played multiple times. A mana cost increase, small hp decrease and increased cooldown for the anihilation of the canon should bring some relief.

Atlas
Atlas got a change in armor classes and hp gain for each module to make him a little stronger in the end game.

Brratu
Brratus damage soaking was enhanced with the last patch, we wanted to strenghen that further. Hp gain for enchantments have been increased, while damage decreased. But don't worry, the big one still does enough damage when his foot hits. 😉

Granite Guardian
The Guardian's asteriodal drop does more damage now and has been increased doublefold. It should therefore also affect stronger units with its impact and not just scratch them. 

Selga
Selga has not been seen too much around, we therefore increased her protection radius. Let's see where it goes from here.

Units
Lich
The lich is one of the strongest units in the game and has been perceived as op by our community. As the lich's frostnova ability plays a big role in that regard, we tuned down its damage and splash-damage, as well as the lich's energy capacity.

Oppressors
Even after the last nerf Oppressors still made other flying units somewhat powerless in a match. We wanted to change that and therefore reduced their range further, which will hopefully allow a more diverse use of flying units. With aimbots and/or void miasma, oppressors can now be brought closer to other flying units fire range, but they will still outrange most - just not so much anymore.
In addition, the change will not allow Oppressors to attack towers with an aimbot and out of tower's fire range anymore. We feel that their roles as strongest air unit and counter vs legendaries (like brrattu, Aegis and the guardian) is still good enough to incorporate and make use of them.

Overseer
The overseer has been reworked and can now attack four enemies. Damage and speed have been adjusted accordingly. Its range has been increased by 1, hopefully making it a better option in the game.

Soul Cauldron
Buffed Cauldrons were able to bring down a tower pretty fast because of its siege damage, which has been consequently reduced. Blast ability remains untouched, as it can be handled by different ways as having buildings in a deck to distribute the dealt damage, using flux field or stone circles.

T1- (tankish) Units
In the current meta t1 units (especially the tankish) play a small role. While some units can be used because of their special abilites, most become unimportant from t2 on. We try to increase their usage, by giving many ot them some small buffs.

See all changes:
https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

notes.title: Patch Notes, New Features & Sunday Tournament Reminder
notes.notes:
Hola Clashers, time for another announcement!

As I mentioned last time, we’ve worked on a patch for today that includes tools for handling AFK players, balancing fixes and our very first version of an observer mode, just in time for the tournament!

The new report feature will allow you to report AFK players, profane deck or player names or even a random teammate that bugged you.

Balancing changes -> here is the full change list (Thanks a bunch to the community members, Wizards and mods - basically everyone - for their ideas and suggestions!!):

https://crystal-clash.com/patch-notes

Our new 3v3 custom game mode that also makes 2v2 + observers possible for tournaments has been implemented. Spectators must join with an empty deck. Please report any issues that you come across, as always.

And lastly, here is the tournament registration link for this Sunday: https://battlefy.com/crystal-clash/february-qualifier-1/6202797cb8e4f87bc14ef3cd/info

Let me remind you that this tournament is going to be the first one of many that grants qualification for the first ever Crystal Clash Championship that will happen later this year, and let me also tell you what rewards you can expect for the tournament!

Rewards are for each players on the team
1st - 90 Premium Days, 5000 Crystals, Tournament Guardian Skin (criteria of at least 16 participating teams has to be fulfilled for winning the Guardian skin) , an exclusive Tournament-Gold-Icon
2nd -  60 Premium Days, 3000 Crystals, an exclusive Tournament-Silver-Icon
3rd -  30 Premium Days, 2000 Crystals, an exclusive Tournament-Bronze-Icon
------
Each participant receives 10 Premium Days and 250 Crystals

On top of that, we will be giving away points to qualify for the bi-yearly championship, but more on that next announcement! For now it’s time to wish you all a nice weekend, and also good luck for Sunday to all the would-be champions!
